speaker: Doctor
text: I must clarify that "sepsis" is a severe systemic infection requiring immediate blood work and vital sign assessment, which I cannot perform without further data; however, given your three-month history of a dry cough and shortness of breath, this presentation is highly suggestive of Tuberculosis or a chronic interstitial lung disease. DIAGNOSIS READY: Tuberculosis
